title: Micro-DSL for runbook steps with interactive telemetry and safe dry-run
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a compact, typed micro-DSL for authoring runbook steps that supports interactive telemetry hooks and a safe dry-run mode. The DSL should emit structured traces and step-level metrics that the Console can consume, and runtime must validate idempotency and side-effect annotations before execution. Deliverables: DSL spec, interpreter library (Go), validation harness, integration tests, and a canary rollout in the ops sandbox. This ticket covers the core language design, runtime safety checks, telemetry schema, and a prototype PR to the runbooks service.
acceptance_criteria: DSL spec doc in Confluence: grammar, types, and side-effect model
Interpreter library builds and passes unit tests on CI
Dry-run mode returns a deterministic execution plan with no side-effectful actions executed
Telemetry emitted for each step: start/finish, latency_ms, outcome, trace_id, step_id
Canary deployment executed in ops sandbox with 3 sample runbooks and dashboards showing step-level traces
tasks: Draft micro-DSL grammar and publish to confluence (owner: Aisha)
Add step idempotency and side-effect annotations to DSL
Implement dry-run evaluator that simulates effects and outputs plan
Define telemetry schema and wire to observability pipeline
Create integration tests exercising safe/unsafe steps and dry-run
Prepare canary runbooks and rollout plan for ops sandbox
comments: 2025-02-13 - Aisha: Initial design sketch added to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Micro-DSL+Sketch. Key trade-offs: expressiveness vs. verifiability. Proposing a small set of primitives (shell, http, sql, call) with explicit effect tags.

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: DSL too expressive leads to unverifiable side effects. Mitigation: limit primitives and require explicit effect tags.
Risk: Dry-run divergence vs real run. Mitigation: add smoke-step execution with mocked endpoints mirrored by contract tests.
Risk: Telemetry volume increase. Mitigation: sample low-importance runs and provide config to redact heavy payloads.
Risk: Secrets exposure in telemetry. Mitigation: redact secret fields and integrate with KMS access logs.
